name: Obsidian LiveSync
description: CouchDB configured for the Self-hosted LiveSync plugin, which syncs Obsidian vaults between desktop and mobile in real time through your own server, end-to-end encrypted if you choose a passphrase in the plugin. The template writes the CORS and size settings the plugin checks for before CouchDB first starts.

access.note: There is no page to sign in to: in Obsidian, the Self-hosted LiveSync plugin connects to https://<domain> with the user name chosen here and the generated COUCHDB_PASSWORD from the Variables tab. CouchDB creates that administrator on the first start only, so change the password later inside CouchDB (/_utils) rather than by rotating the variable.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: The server address the plugin is configured with; it must be HTTPS for the mobile app.

inputs.name: user
inputs.label: CouchDB user
inputs.description: The administrator the plugin signs in as.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The CouchDB API the plugin replicates through, and the Fauxton admin at /_utils

volumes.name: config
volumes.purpose: CouchDB's settings, the administrator and the LiveSync options

install.content:
; Written by Just Dashboard before the first start: the settings the Self-hosted
; LiveSync plugin checks for. CouchDB writes later changes to the last file here.
[couchdb]
single_node = true
max_document_size = 50000000

[chttpd]
max_http_request_size = 4294967296
enable_cors = true

[chttpd_auth]
require_valid_user = true
require_valid_user_except_for_up = true

[httpd]
WWW-Authenticate = Basic realm="couchdb"
enable_cors = true

[cors]
origins = app://obsidian.md,capacitor://localhost,http://localhost
credentials = true
headers = accept, authorization, content-type, origin, referer
methods = GET, PUT, POST, HEAD, DELETE
max_age = 3600

update.notes: CouchDB 3.x upgrades in place. The settings file is written once; changes made from Fauxton are kept in the config volume.

secrets.name: password
secrets.label: CouchDB password
secrets.description: The administrator's password, which the plugin is configured with.
